records-needed-to-decide-the-proposal.text: Records needed to decide the proposal.

As a model reviewer, I want to see exactly what an identity or evidence record contains and which assertions are still hypothetical. | Record | Required fields and relationships | Validation | |---|---|---| | Authority binding | repository revision, path, declaration, digest, acceptance status and source of ruling | Source presence does not imply acceptance; changed identities reopen dependent evidence. | | Candidate identity | application identity, state-policy identity, registry asset name, token kind and canonical key | Keep complete policy/name identity; do not erase policy until the claimed cross-policy uniqueness is proved under accepted premises. | | Naming premise | exact preimage encoding, hash domain, applicable finite preimage set, explicit proposition and satisfying witness | Unambiguous encoding and collision assumptions are separate; no unconditional finite-hash injectivity. | | Ledger case | accepted-history prefix, seed reference, policies invoked, input/output assets, redeemers and candidate state effect | Same-transaction multiple-policy use differs from across-history reuse; reuse #679/#680 vocabulary when bound. | | Custody observation | key, registry, holder role, pending request identity, active asset, available evidence and observation provenance | Count genuine tokens in application custody and pending requests; missing evidence cannot prove terminal/never registered. | | Changed obligation | readable guarantee, old declaration/digest, candidate declaration/digest, premise, consumer list and disposition | Every changed definition/theorem/observation is preserved, restated, retired by ruling or explicitly unresolved. | | Decision evidence | candidate, command, actual exit, proof/axiom or counterexample pointers, audit stage and uncovered implementation claims | PROVED, REFUTED and OPEN remain distinct; only the operator rules on a semantic conflict. |

configuration-and-application-controls.text: The bound root Config contains the four policy pins plus root, minimum tip, processing/reclaim windows, registry identity, registration cost and booking width. The four-field proposal is not adopted by this plan. The investigation must account for each field and preserve every required economic obligation. The bound application has a registry-parameterized App and protected Control fields. Changing that dependency requires a recorded comparison of controller update, genuine-token release and pending-custody behavior. This table specifies no replacement wire datum.

frozen-candidate-records.text: These records are hypotheses under the identity, role and hash questions, constrained by the complete-identity ruling. They define no ledger laws or wire migration. | Record | Fields or constructors | Scope | |---|---|---| | Payload | edge key owner destination nonce : Nat | Existing authorization tuple and booking nonce remain explicit. | | Role | state witness trieReady application | Four classification cases, discovered from compiled constructors. | | Binding | full nameOnly | Ruled complete binding and rejected name-only contrast. | | Reading | policyOnly authenticated | Unresolved recognition alternatives. | | Preimage | application release; statePolicy appPolicy; seed OutRef; role Role TokenId key; approval TokenId Payload | Tagged structural domains with complete identities. Name-only contrast replaces the policy component by zero. | | Observation | asset : TokenId, stateDatum : Bool, provenance : TokenId | Provenance is explicit authenticated-origin evidence with external validity still a premise. Fabricating a datum changes no asset or provenance. | | TxOutput | assets : List (TokenId × Nat) | Asset counts only; no fee or script semantics. | | TxView | spent : List OutRef, outputs : List TxOutput, mint : List (TokenId × Int), invoked : List Nat | Observation only; quantities sum per complete asset; history is a list of views. | | Query, Scenario | Named public case, finite hash table, explicit application/registry/payload/key/assets, observation, seed, transaction and history; scenario adds a mutation selector | Generic oracle input only, with no theorem-specific projection. none selects the candidate; other selectors serve the mutant ledger. | | Guard | Full/name-only approval, policy-state, four authenticated roles, genesis seed count, history uniqueness | Selector is none or flip Guard; exactly one guard changes. | | Statement ledger | theorem, compiled statement digest, status, question/ruling, witness declarations, selectors, optional inversion case | Rejected readings have a separate status marker. | | Mutant ledger | theorem, selector, premise/positive/falsification declarations | Candidate and selector evaluate the same instance; no unrelated mutant function. | The minimal transaction view must later bind to accepted ledger/history vocabulary, as impact.md records. It cannot establish ledger validity, lineage, custody, supply or real hash collision freedom. Economic configuration and the termination custody ruling belong to subsequent stages.
